title: Clap synthesis parameters
description: Synthesis parameters for one deterministic clap sample (v0.2: v0.1 plus the optional extreme-sound fields, #280; v0.1 proposal #229). Only schema_version and seed are required; an omitted field takes the default named in its description. Out-of-range values are rejected, never clamped. Time t is measured from the first burst (sample n_off with offset_ms). Voice: seeded white noise, band-passed (RBJ band-pass, constant 0 dB peak) before the envelope, then `bursts` short exponential bursts spaced `burst_spacing_ms` apart, then one longer tail; high-passed after the envelope. Ranges and defaults are a proposal from docs/research/2026-10-29_bandit-wheel-synthesis-transfer.md 4.1 and docs/research/2026-11-02_next-category-proposal.md; the audio-engineer measures them and may adjust them in the engine PR (a contract-change then). Snare and rim are not part of v0.1 or v0.2; they would be added later as a `voice` field or as their own contract. v0.2 fields (fold, crush, rate_div, ring_hz, ring_mix, comb_hz, comb_fb, gate_ms, tail_reverse) are allowed only with schema_version 0.2; they sit in the allOf branch for 0.2 and the root uses unevaluatedProperties so a 0.1 document carrying one is rejected (the root properties stay the v0.1 set, as the orchestrator tool builder and the engine's default filling read them); each has an off value (0 / 1 / false) that skips its stage, so a 0.2 document with every new field off renders the bytes of its 0.1 twin. Out-of-range values are rejected, never clamped. Signal order: noise, band-pass, envelope, [crush, rate_div, ring, comb], hp_hz high-pass, room, fold, drive, [gate_ms, tail_reverse], fade-out, mean removal, ceiling. t60_ms is not a target for extreme presets (relative to the peak; distortion lifts the tail).
$comment: Shared field names keep the meaning they have in kick-params (seed, variants, bpm, sample_rate, bit_depth, length_ms, drive, polarity, offset_ms, peak_ceiling_dbfs, preset). tests/test_contracts.py pins that the shared definitions are identical where they are copies. The file length is not derived: a clap shorter than its tail is cut off and gets the same 5 ms fade-out as the kick. The longest burst onset is (bursts - 1) * burst_spacing_ms = 5 * 30 = 150 ms, below the minimum length_ms of 200, so no cross-field rule is needed. Engine identity for sidecars: engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-clap' with the clap engine's own version (sample-metadata.schema.json, D-025).

schema_version.description: 0.1: the fields up to preset. 0.2: may also carry the v0.2 fields (fold ... tail_reverse); every 0.1 document stays valid and renders unchanged.

seed.description: Seeds the noise (one sub-stream per layer). Same parameters and seed give a byte-identical WAV.

length_ms.description: File length. If shorter than the tail needs, the clap is cut off and gets a 5 ms fade-out.

bursts.description: Number of short bursts before the tail. 1 = a single noise hit with a tail.

burst_spacing_ms.description: Time between burst onsets, ms. The tail starts one spacing after the last burst onset.

burst_decay_ms.description: Time for each burst to fall 60 dB after its onset (same definition as kick amp_decay_ms). Exponential.

burst_level_falloff.description: Level of burst k+1 = level of burst k times this value; the first burst has level 1. 1 = equal bursts.

tail_level.description: Tail start level relative to the first burst. 0 = no tail.

tail_decay_ms.description: Time for the tail to fall 60 dB after its start. Exponential.

bp_hz.description: Centre of the band-pass on the noise, Hz.

bp_q.description: Q of the band-pass (RBJ). Low = wide, noisy; high = narrow, more tonal.

hp_hz.description: Corner of the high-pass after the envelope, Hz.

room.description: Wet amount of a seeded noise-impulse-response room. 0 = dry (no convolution).

room_length_ms.description: Length of the room impulse response, ms. Has no effect at room 0.

drive.description: Anti-aliased saturation, same stage as kick drive. 0 = off.

polarity.description: Sign of the whole output, applied after the peak ceiling.

offset_ms.description: Silence before the first burst, rounded to whole samples (as in kick-params).

peak_ceiling_dbfs.description: Peak ceiling of the quantised file.

preset.description: Name of the preset these values came from, if any.

fold.description: v0.2. Sine wave folding after room, before drive, on the peak-normalised signal: sin(k * pi * u / 2) with k = 1 + 15 * fold (smooth curve only; no triangle fold). Oversampled like drive. Default (filled by the engine for 0.2 only): 0 = stage skipped.

crush.description: v0.2. Bit reduction before the hp_hz high-pass: bits = 12 - 9 * crush (12 down to 3), round-to-nearest, no dither. The aliasing is the effect, not an error. Default (filled by the engine for 0.2 only): 0 = stage skipped.

rate_div.description: v0.2. Sample-and-hold rate reduction by this factor, before the hp_hz high-pass (the products at high factors fall below its corner). Default (filled by the engine for 0.2 only): 1 = stage skipped.

ring_hz.description: v0.2. Carrier of the ring modulator, Hz, before the hp_hz high-pass. No effect at ring_mix 0. Default (filled by the engine for 0.2 only): 440 (inactive while ring_mix is 0).

ring_mix.description: v0.2. Dry/ring-modulated mix. Default (filled by the engine for 0.2 only): 0 = stage skipped (ring_hz ignored).

comb_hz.description: v0.2. Feedback comb tuned to this frequency (delay = round(sample_rate / comb_hz) samples), before the hp_hz high-pass. No effect at comb_fb 0. Default (filled by the engine for 0.2 only): 800 (inactive while comb_fb is 0).

comb_fb.description: v0.2. Feedback of the comb, always below 1 (stable). Default (filled by the engine for 0.2 only): 0 = stage skipped (comb_hz ignored).

gate_ms.description: v0.2. Hard gate length after drive: the sound is cut this many ms after the first burst, with a 1 ms fade. 0 = off (stage skipped); otherwise 5 ... 500. Default (filled by the engine for 0.2 only): 0.

tail_reverse.description: v0.2. Reverse the tail segment (from the end of the burst region) in time, after drive and before the fade-out. The loudest part then sits at the end of the file, so a short length_ms cuts the swell. Default (filled by the engine for 0.2 only): false = stage skipped.
